create_PythonDataSource: create a PythonDataSource with a length and a getitem callable to build an indexable data source
test_PythonDataSource_iteration: test iterating over a PythonDataSource to verify each element matches its index
test_PythonDataSource_pickle: test pickling and unpickling a PythonDataSource to verify it remains accessible after serialization
test_PythonDataSource_tree_map: test applying tree.map_structure over a PythonDataSource to verify function calls on each element
test_PythonDataSource_len: test the PythonDataSource __len__ method returns the configured length value
